verdict.rationale: Grok is an API-first product, which makes it headless by design. It offers self-serve API keys exported as environment variables with runnable curl/Python/JS requests, REST and gRPC APIs, OpenAI compatibility, and an async Batch API for large automated workloads. A Grok Build CLI is also mentioned for agentic coding. Missing for 10: explicit CI/pipeline integration docs (e.g., GitHub Actions or non-interactive CLI flags), documentation of Grok Build's headless mode, and independent hands-on reports of CI usage.
